category_title: High school student with AD/HD exhibiting inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity
scenario_title: Traditional biology theory lesson without ICT
minimal_context: Marios is sitting in a traditional biology classroom, tasked with completing a worksheet based on an explanatory presentation of Lamarck's theory.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Marios, please look at the explanatory presentation on the board and use it to fill out your worksheet on Lamarck's theory.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am not very interested... but OK... it is a relatively nice course.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to answer the first question on the worksheet based on the presentation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I believe that biology is a course that a part of it should be carried out in the laboratory. No matter how good is the teacher’s intention and no matter how well he is informed a student cannot accept all these theories without seeing them happen.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish this worksheet right now. Keep trying to write down the answers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Daydreaming and looking toward the hallway) I missed the points necessary to complete the activity. I can't focus my attention on the details, it demands too much mental effort.

task.content: Reconstruction of students’ ideas through an explanatory presentation of the basic points of Lamarck’s theory with the use of appropriate worksheets.

context.environment: Traditional 2-hour biology lesson on Lamarck's theory
context.social_setting: Classroom setting without the use of ICT

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: in-class activities that demanded mental efforts
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: could not focus his attention to details, he made a lot of mistakes due to failure to concentrate, he was finding difficulties to maintain his attention to his duties, and he was also finding difficulties to complete his duties and tasks. He also seemed to daydream during the class.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: not satisfied by the way biology is being taught in school... considered the biology course being very demanding and needing a lot of analysis
